subject: easyJet cabin crew strike at the Lisbon, Porto and Faro bases
said: easyJet cabin crew strike called for 19 to 23 December (status: announced; shown from the first version of /disruptions/, commit 2a674ca)

happened: SNPVAC called the strike off on 18 November 2026, after an easyJet proposal in DGERT conciliation; talks set for 20, 23 and 25 November; new action not ruled out.
